name: Nilesh Behede
player_statement:
A complete player, Nilesh Behede has made a big mark in cricket. With 15 turns at the crease, they've hit a top score of 44*, with an average of 41.83 and a quick strike rate of 137.16. Their knack for hitting big shots is evident with 22 sixes and 11 fours.

Equally good at bowling, they've bowled 22.1 overs, taking 5 wickets at an economy rate of 7.35. Despite a few wides, their accuracy is top-notch, making them a key player for their team.
